entities.summary: Johannes Gutenberg's development of movable-type printing in Mainz (c. 1440–1455) was the most important technological innovation of the second millennium. The Gutenberg Bible (1455) demonstrated mass-producible books, reducing costs by 80% within decades. Printing enabled the Reformation, the Scientific Revolution, the Enlightenment, and the democratization of knowledge.
